import random
random.seed(880608)
N=50000
true_conflicts=0
object_misses=0
predicate_caught=0
global_reject=0
predicate_reject=0
for _ in range(N):
    a=random.randrange(500)
    if random.random()<0.30:
        b=a
    else:
        b=random.randrange(500)
    conflict=(a==b)
    global_reject += 1
    if conflict:
        true_conflicts += 1
        # both transactions read the empty predicate and insert distinct row ids; row/object OCC sees no shared object version
        object_misses += 1
        # predicate/invariant epoch for logical slot changes after first commit
        predicate_caught += 1
        predicate_reject += 1
print({'n_pairs':N,'true_conflicts':true_conflicts,'object_only_misses':object_misses,'object_miss_rate_given_conflict':object_misses/true_conflicts,'predicate_detection_given_conflict':predicate_caught/true_conflicts,'global_second_reject_rate':global_reject/N,'predicate_scoped_second_reject_rate':predicate_reject/N})
